caseName: Horn v. Saranchak ex rel. Troup
caseNameFull: Horn, Commissioner, Pennsylvania Department of Corrections v. Saranchak, by His Next Friends, Troup

opinions.text: Application to vacate the stay of execution of sentence of death entered by the United States Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit on November 8, 2000, presented to Justice Souter, and by him referred to the Court, denied.
